avoid: Pulling too hard on neighboring belts
children.game_version: Children form a half-circle holding belts and practice staying connected while marching to 2/4 music.

seniors.seated_version: Seated in a semi-circle, participants hold hands or lap-belts left-over-right while tapping feet on 2/4 counts.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the half-circle step with reduced travel, maintaining stable belt hold or light hand contact.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Slower tempo than medium-fast, smaller step range.

learning_units.description: Establish the crossed belt hold in half-circle formation.
Execute medium-fast 2/4 steps using whole feet.

social_formats.description: Women's line dance in a half-circle formation linked by belts.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Left hand over right hand holding neighbors' belts.
movement_profile.footwork: Whole feet stepping at medium-fast tempo.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Flat grounded stepping on whole feet without jumps described.
movement_profile.partnering: Belt hold in line formation (left hand over right hand).
movement_profile.posture: Upright line stance, holding neighboring belts.

signature_moves.description: Dancers link by placing their left hand over the right hand while grasping adjacent dancers' belts.
signature_moves.name: Belt hold (Повратено зафат)

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid dancing on toes; maintain full contact with whole feet as described.

music_profile.sound_description: Traditional Macedonian folk music in a steady 2/4 duple meter accompanying medium-fast line dance stepping.

basic_steps: Form a half circle with other women dancers.
Grasp the belts of adjacent dancers with the left hand crossed over the right hand.
Step on whole feet at a medium-fast tempo in 2/4 meter.
teaching.level_notes: Medium-fast tempo executed on whole feet while maintaining an interlocking belt hold.
